This gallery compiles aradamawakka's works themed around the Maldives (also known as Takanashi Island.)

The original Japanese images are from the artist's Pixiv page.

The translation is by me. Note that I'm not proficient in Japanese but I can read it and understand the grammar a bit. Let me know if something is inaccurate and I'll update the gallery.

[TL Notes]
The Forty-Eight Moves is basically the Japanese version of the Kama Sutra minus the yapping. Curiously, this name is shared with the Forty-Eight winning moves of sumo. From what I gather, the number forty-eight was considered auspicious and used to denote something that comes in large numbers. See page 31 for some pictures, plus:
- Booklet with IRL photos: https://en.jrants.com/oedo-48-moves-catalog-photobook-edo-48-sex-positions/1
